title: Kids and psychologists team up to learn from one another (SOP40)

sentences.en: Going to therapy is probably one of the most common ways the average person sees a psychologist at work.
sentences.zh: 去诊所接受心理治疗，可能是普通人接触心理学家工作最常见的方式之一。

sentences.en: Some museums are trying to change that.
sentences.zh: 一些博物馆正试图改变这种状况。

sentences.en: A program called the Living Laboratory is breaking down the barriers between psychological scientists and the public
sentences.zh: 一个名为“生活实验室”的项目正在打破心理学研究人员与公众之间的壁垒，

sentences.en: by having museum visitors and their children see and participate in actual psychological experiments.
sentences.zh: 通过让博物馆的参观者及其孩子观看并参与实际的心理学实验。

sentences.en: And it's become a learning experience for the participants and the scientists.
sentences.zh: 这已经成为参与者和科学家共同的学习经历。

sentences.en: I'm Audrey Hamilton, and this is Speaking of Psychology.
sentences.zh: 我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿，这里是《心理学话语》栏目。

sentences.en: Peter Blake is an assistant professor of psychology and director of the Social Development and Learning Lab at Boston University.
sentences.zh: 彼得·布莱克是波士顿大学心理学助理教授兼社会发展与学习实验室主任。

sentences.en: He studies how children learn to become cooperative members of society.
sentences.zh: 他研究儿童如何学习成为社会中具有合作精神的成员。

sentences.en: Specifically, he uses experiments to investigate children's altruism, fairness, and other social behaviors in different cultures.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，他通过实验来探究儿童在不同文化中的利他主义、公平感以及其他社会行为。

sentences.en: Over the last 10 years, he's worked to bring the lab to the general public by collaborating with the Boston Museum of Science as part of the Living Laboratory,
sentences.zh: 在过去的10年里，他通过与波士顿科学博物馆合作，将实验室带给广大公众，这是“生活实验室”项目的一部分。

sentences.en: a nationwide program that aims to help grown-ups understand children's development by immersing museum visitors in the process of scientific discovery.
sentences.zh: 这是一个全国性的项目，旨在通过让博物馆参观者沉浸在科学发现的过程中，帮助成年人理解儿童的发展。

sentences.en: Welcome, Dr. Blake.
sentences.zh: 欢迎您，布莱克博士。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Let's talk about the Living Laboratory at the Museum of Science.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈科学博物馆里的生活实验室吧。

sentences.en: From what I understand, psychologists are working in museums, conducting experiments with volunteers.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，心理学家们正在博物馆里工作，与志愿者一起进行实验。

sentences.en: It's fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这太迷人了。

sentences.en: What was the idea behind this project, and how does it work?
sentences.zh: 这个项目背后的理念是什么？它是如何运作的？

sentences.en: Researchers in the Boston area, there's a lot of psychology labs around here.
sentences.zh: 波士顿地区的研人员，这附近有很多心理学实验室。

sentences.en: We were interested in where we could get subjects, particularly developmental psychologists
sentences.zh: 我们对去哪里寻找受试者很感兴趣，尤其是发展心理学家，

sentences.en: are always looking for new populations of children or access to children and families that we can teSt.
sentences.zh: 总是急需寻找新的儿童群体，或者接触可以进行测试的儿童和家庭的渠道。

sentences.en: And the Museum of Science was interested in having scientists come into the museum and explain what they're doing to parents and their children as well.
sentences.zh: 而科学博物馆则希望科学家们能来到博物馆，向家长和孩子们解释他们在做什么。

sentences.en: So about 10, probably more than 10 years ago at this point, there was a meeting of the minds,
sentences.zh: 因此，大约在10年前，可能现在不止10年前了，大家思想碰撞了一下，

sentences.en: and we agreed to start doing research at this one area of the Museum of Science in Boston.
sentences.zh: 我们同意开始在波士顿科学博物馆的这个区域进行研究。

sentences.en: And this, over several years, this grew into a more formal program that is specifically about,
sentences.zh: 经过几年的发展，这演变成了一个更加正式的项目，其核心在于，

sentences.en: not just about us collecting data, but also about scientists engaging in education with the public.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是我们收集数据，还包括科学家与公众开展教育互动。

sentences.en: So it's kind of a research-education collaborative.
sentences.zh: 所以它有点像一个研究与教育的合作项目。

sentences.en: And we've developed this, and it's become more clearly defined, and now it's kind of a, there's a shared value system that we have in working with the Museum of Science.
sentences.zh: 我们对它进行了开发，使其更加明确，现在它变成了一种与科学博物馆共同拥有的价值体系。

sentences.en: So I can go into more detail on some of that, if you'd like.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意的话，我可以详细介绍其中一些内容。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, the psychological experiments, they appear to be a good fit for these types of venues.
sentences.zh: 好的，我的意思是，心理学实验似乎非常适合这种类型的场所。

sentences.en: And you've conducted, like you said, research in these museuMs.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，你已经在这些博物馆里开展了研究。

sentences.en: Can you tell us about some of those experiments and what you found?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们讲讲其中一些实验以及你的发现吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: So we do things, we have to design our experiments specifically for this kind of environment.
sentences.zh: 我们所做的事情，必须专门为这种环境设计我们的实验。

sentences.en: But in the museum environment, it's actually quite similar to running experiments in preschools or in elementary schools.
sentences.zh: 但在博物馆的环境中，其实和在幼儿园或小学里做实验非常相似。

sentences.en: This is something that developmental psychologists have done for generations.
sentences.zh: 这是几代发展心理学家一直在做的事情。

sentences.en: So that's a standard practice.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种标准做法。

sentences.en: But we don't run the studies.
sentences.zh: 但我们不会开展那种很长的研究。

sentences.en: The studies can't be an hour long, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，研究不能长达一个小时。

sentences.en: That's kind of rare.
sentences.zh: 那比较少见。

sentences.en: So we have to be sensitive to the fact that parents are there with their kids.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须考虑到这样一个事实：家长是带着孩子来的。

sentences.en: They want to get some experience.
sentences.zh: 他们想获得一些体验。

sentences.en: They are interested in the science of what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 他们对我们所做研究背后的科学很感兴趣。

sentences.en: Here's an opportunity for their kids to do an experiment, and it'll only take maybe 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 这里有一个让孩子们做实验的机会，而且可能只需要大约10分钟。

sentences.en: So it's a very safe way for parents to get engaged in the process.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于家长来说，这是一种非常安全的方式来参与这个过程。

sentences.en: Parents are always interested in how their kids are thinking and how they behave.
sentences.zh: 家长总是对孩子们的思考方式和行为方式很感兴趣。

sentences.en: So this is something they're eager to participate in.
sentences.zh: 所以这是他们很乐意参与的事情。

sentences.en: The kinds of experiments that I've been doing specifically, kids really enjoy them because they usually get some sort of prize.
sentences.zh: 我具体做的那类实验，孩子们真的很喜欢，因为他们通常能得到某种奖励。

sentences.en: For altruism, for example, we'll give kids a set of stickers and we'll tell them that you can keep them all for yourself or you can give some to another child.
sentences.zh: 例如，关于利他主义，我们会给孩子们一套贴纸，并告诉他们，你可以把它们全部留给自己，也可以送一些给另一个孩子。

sentences.en: And this basic setup, when it's done by economists, the idea is that the child gets to act as a dictator.
sentences.zh: 这种基本的设置，当由经济学家来做时，其理念是让孩子扮演独裁者的角色。

sentences.en: They get to make a decision about what they're going to get and what this other child is going to get.
sentences.zh: 他们可以自己决定自己能得到什么，以及另一个孩子能得到什么。

sentences.en: Giving is costly.
sentences.zh: 给予是有成本的。

sentences.en: So this is a behavior that has some consequences for them.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种会产生一定后果的行为。

sentences.en: And this works really well in the Museum of Science.
sentences.zh: 这在科学博物馆里效果非常好。

sentences.en: We can do this quickly.
sentences.zh: 我们可以很快地完成。

sentences.en: And we've been able to compare the results there to what we get in the lab, what we get in schools, and in other settings.
sentences.zh: 我们已经能够将那里的结果与我们在实验室、学校以及其他环境中获得的结果进行比较。

sentences.en: And so far, everything looks very consistent.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，一切看起来都非常一致。

sentences.en: So that's one very simple basic game.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常简单基础的游戏。

sentences.en: And what we've done over time, once we establish that children,
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，我们所做的是，一旦我们确定了孩子们，

sentences.en: the basic result is that children who are younger than about six years of age will keep more than for themselves in that setup and a baseline.
sentences.zh: 基本结果是，在那种基准设置下，大约6岁以下的儿童会为自己留下比别人更多的东西。

sentences.en: And then they tend to approach giving an equal split as they get closer to six, seven, and eight.
sentences.zh: 而当他们接近6岁、7岁和8岁时，他们往往倾向于平均分配。

sentences.en: So what we've done with that and what other researchers now do quite regularly, we use that giving measure as our dependent experimental manipulation before that,
sentences.zh: 所以我们用它做了什么，以及其他研究人员现在经常做的事情是，在那之前，我们使用这个给予指标作为我们的因变量实验操作，

sentences.en: our different conditions, and see if we can increase or decrease children's giving.
sentences.zh: 也就是我们不同的条件，来看看我们是否能增加或减少儿童的给予行为。

sentences.en: So in that way, we can study what are the factors that help children engage in more altruistic behavior and what can deprive.
sentences.zh: 通过这种方式，我们可以研究究竟是什么因素帮助儿童参与更多利他行为，又是什么因素会削弱这种行为。

sentences.en: And I'm sure a lot of parents find that very interesting.
sentences.zh: 我确信很多家长对此非常感兴趣。

sentences.en: I mean, they want to know, how do I make my child a more giving child, a more kind child, maybe a more empathetic child?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们想知道，我怎样才能让我的孩子变得更慷慨、更善良，也许还更有同理心？

sentences.en: So how do they react when you get them involved, them and their children?
sentences.zh: 那么，当你让他们参与进来，让他们和孩子参与时，他们的反应如何？

sentences.en: You know, what do they get out of this experience?
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们从这段经历中得到了什么？

sentences.en: So that's one of the great things about this environment is that we recruit the parents right there.
sentences.zh: 所以这种环境的棒点之一就是我们就在那里招募家长。

sentences.en: We get their consent.
sentences.zh: 我们征得他们的同意。

sentences.en: The child participates in our setup.
sentences.zh: 孩子参与我们的装置。

sentences.en: The parents can watch what the child does.
sentences.zh: 家长可以观察孩子的行为。

sentences.en: We ask them not to interfere, obviously.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，我们会要求他们不要干涉。

sentences.en: And then we can talk to them right afterwards about what just happened.
sentences.zh: 然后我们可以紧接着与他们交流刚刚发生了什么。

sentences.en: And for the altruism games, children are often quite selfish, and parents are often a little bit surprised or embarrassed.
sentences.zh: 在利他主义游戏中，孩子们通常相当自私，家长们往往会感到有点惊讶或尴尬。

sentences.en: But it leads to some great conversations about, like, oh, this really, you know, surprising.
sentences.zh: 但这引发了一些极好的对话，比如，哦，这真的，你知道，太让人意外了。

sentences.en: Like, yeah, this is completely typical.
sentences.zh: 比如，是的，这完全是典型的。

sentences.en: You know, we always have to consider that this is a, you know, we can't make a prediction for your particular child.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们总是必须考虑到，这是一个，你知道，我们无法对你特定的孩子做出预测。

sentences.en: But we do have a general sense of what are the factors that can cause children to be more altruistic under different conditions.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实对在不同条件下导致儿童更具利他性的因素有了大致的了解。

sentences.en: And we also have an opportunity to explain a bit of the science.
sentences.zh: 我们也有机会解释一点科学原理。

sentences.en: We typically will run our conditions as between-subjects conditions.
sentences.zh: 我们通常会将实验条件设置为被试间条件。

sentences.en: And that just means that children only receive one experimental manipulation.
sentences.zh: 这仅仅意味着孩子们只接受一种实验操作。

sentences.en: So parents who are watching this just see that their child did a search task or something before this.
sentences.zh: 所以正在观看这一过程的家长只会看到他们的孩子在此之前完成了一个搜索任务或类似的事情。

sentences.en: And they're like, well, isn't that the thing that's driving the effect?
sentences.zh: 他们会想，嗯，难道不是那个东西在驱动这个效果吗？

sentences.en: And like, well, we can only tell that if we compare it to a control condition where they're doing some other kind of task.
sentences.zh: 而我们会说，嗯，只有当我们把它与他们做其他某种任务的控制条件进行比较时，我们才能知道这一点。

sentences.en: So it gives us a chance to explain to the parents what our science is about.
sentences.zh: 所以这给了我们一个机会向家长解释我们的科学是关于什么的。

sentences.en: And I guess this leads into my next question.
sentences.zh: 我想这也顺理成章地引出了我的下一个问题。

sentences.en: You know, why not?
sentences.zh: 你知道，为什么不呢？

sentences.en: It sounds like this is not only educational for the parents, even maybe some of the children, but for you, the researchers.
sentences.zh: 听起来这不仅对家长，甚至可能对某些孩子具有教育意义，对你们研究人员来说也是如此。

sentences.en: You know, you're out of a controlled laboratory setting.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你走出了受控的实验室环境。

sentences.en: You're in a dynamic setting.
sentences.zh: 你身处一个充满活力的环境中。

sentences.en: I mean, what are the advantages of that?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这样做有什么好处？

sentences.en: Yeah, this has been a real learning experience for everyone who's been involved in the Learning Lab project.
sentences.zh: 是的，对于所有参与学习实验室项目的人来说，这都是一次真正的学习经历。

sentences.en: And one of the benefits to the researchers, kind of initially an unexpected benefit and a bit of a challenge,
sentences.zh: 对于研究人员而言，好处之一（最初算是一个意料之外的好处，也是一个小小的挑战）是，

sentences.en: was that we were forced to really find ways to explain our studies to parents and to other people who are present quickly.
sentences.zh: 我们被迫真正找到方法，向家长和在场的其他人快速解释我们的研究。

sentences.en: Quickly, quickly, clearly, and truthfully, accurately.
sentences.zh: 快速、清晰且真实、准确地解释。

sentences.en: And so this is something where, as we worked, the researchers worked with the educators at the Museum of Science.
sentences.zh: 所以在这个过程中，研究人员与科学博物馆的教育工作者进行了合作。

sentences.en: We learned a lot from them, because this is what they do.
sentences.zh: 我们从他们身上学到了很多，因为这就是他们的本职工作。

sentences.en: That's what they do.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们所做的事。

sentences.en: So they're like, okay, well, if you explain your study to me, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以他们会说，好吧，如果你把你的研究解释给我听，你知道，

sentences.en: I'll give you advice on how you might want to present it to the public.
sentences.zh: 我会就你如何向公众展示它提出建议。

sentences.en: And that helps to take the jargon out of it and present things in a clear way with examples.
sentences.zh: 这有助于去除其中的行话，并通过例子以清晰的方式展示事物。

sentences.en: So that's been one of the benefits.
sentences.zh: 所以这是好处之一。

sentences.en: And now we push it down to we have our, I have my graduate students go and run this.
sentences.zh: 现在我们把它向下推进，让我们的，让我的研究生去运行这个项目。

sentences.en: And as part of it, they have to come up with explanations.
sentences.zh: 作为其中的一部分，他们必须想出解释的方式。

sentences.en: Often a parent really doesn't, is, just wants to hear like the two-second version.
sentences.zh: 通常，家长其实并不需要，只是想听两秒钟的版本。

sentences.en: And that's fine.
sentences.zh: 那也很好。

sentences.en: But you have to be able to say like, so this is what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 但你必须能够说，这就是我们在做的事情。

sentences.en: This is what, you know, we found in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是，你知道的，我们在过去发现的。

sentences.en: That's great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: See you later.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: But then another parent, you know, they might say, well, tell me more.
sentences.zh: 但接着另一位家长，你知道，他们可能会说，嗯，多告诉我一点。

sentences.en: So now you have the three-minute version.
sentences.zh: 所以现在你有了三分钟的版本。

sentences.en: And this can expand into like different levels of discussion.
sentences.zh: 这可以扩展到不同层级的讨论。

sentences.en: And each of those levels of communication has to be correct, right?
sentences.zh: 而每一个层级的沟通都必须是正确的，对吧？

sentences.en: So this is often a bit of a challenge.
sentences.zh: 所以这通常有点挑战性。

sentences.en: One of the ways that the museum has helped us do this is they create handouts.
sentences.zh: 博物馆帮助我们做到这一点的方法之一是他们制作了宣传册。

sentences.en: It's just a two-side, very small thing that we can hand to parents that says, this is what it's about.
sentences.zh: 这只是一份双面的、非常小的小册子，我们可以把它交个家长，上面写着，这就是这项研究的内容。

sentences.en: This is what we found in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们过去发现的。

sentences.en: And here are some things you can try at home to play around with this idea with your own child.
sentences.zh: 这里有一些你可以在家里尝试的方法，以便和你的孩子一起围绕这个想法做游戏。

sentences.en: These aren't things, you know, what you do at home.
sentences.zh: 这些事情并不是，你知道的，你在家里做的事。

sentences.en: That's not something I usually think about.
sentences.zh: 那不是我通常会考虑的事情。

sentences.en: So it really challenges us to come up with ways to convey why this is important and interesting.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实挑战了我们，让我们想方设法传达为什么这很重要且有趣。

sentences.en: Do you think it's getting psychology and the idea of psychology as a science out there to the general public as well?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是否也将心理学以及将心理学视为一门科学的理念传递给了广大公众？

sentences.en: One way we convey that it's a science is by explaining like this is an experiment with different conditions.
sentences.zh: 我们传达这门学科是科学的一种方式是通过解释，比如这是一个具有不同条件的实验。

sentences.en: That seems to impress on people that we're doing something scientific.
sentences.zh: 这似乎给人们留下了深刻的印象，让我们觉得我们在做一些科学的事情。

sentences.en: And we also, this sounds very silly, but like one thing that we mentioned is that, yes, we run statistics, real effect.
sentences.zh: 我们还，这听起来很傻，但我们提到的一点是，是的，我们运行统计数据，真正的效应。

sentences.en: And just adding the math piece seems to give some legitimacy that like, oh, okay, and interpreting them.
sentences.zh: 仅仅加上数学这一块，似乎就赋予了一些合法性，比如，哦，好吧，以及对它们的解释。

sentences.en: You actually have quantitative measures that are doing math.
sentences.zh: 你实际上拥有进行数学计算的定量指标。

sentences.en: That seems to impress upon people that like, oh, okay, that might be a science then.
sentences.zh: 这似乎给人们留下了深刻的印象，比如，哦，好吧，那这可能真的是一门科学。

sentences.en: Well, it seems to be doing really well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它看起来进展得非常顺利。

sentences.en: There are more than 25 living laboratories and museums across the country.
sentences.zh: 全国有25个以上的“生活实验室”和博物馆。

sentences.en: I mean, what does the future look like for these types of programs?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这类项目的未来会是什么样子？

sentences.en: It's really, it has grown rapidly due to a large NSF grant that the Museum of Science got to spread this.
sentences.zh: 它确实，由于科学博物馆获得了美国国家科学基金会的大笔资助来推广这一项目，它得到了迅速的发展。

sentences.en: And it's spread beyond.
sentences.zh: 而且它已经传播到了更广的范围。

sentences.en: There are 25 living laboratories, but a lot of other research labs have set up their own independent, have explored independent connections with museums as well.
sentences.zh: 虽然有25个生活实验室，但许多其他研究实验室也建立了自己的独立机构，并探索了与博物馆的独立联系。

sentences.en: And to give you one striking example, one of my colleagues that I started doing this work with the Museum of Science,
sentences.zh: 为了给你举一个引人注目的例子，我和他一起在科学博物馆开始这项工作的同事之一，

sentences.en: Andrew Barron, who's at University of British Columbia, he, when he moved up there, he set up his own relationship with the museum in Vancouver.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·巴伦，他在不列颠哥伦比亚大学，当他搬到那里时，他与温哥华的博物馆建立了合作关系。

sentences.en: He told us that he's been testing thousands of kids a year.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们，他每年要测试数千名儿童。

sentences.en: So it's become a, it's a real, I don't like to say it's a gold mine, but, because that really emphasizes just the data collection aspect.
sentences.zh: 所以这已经成为一个，这是一个真正的，我不想说这是一个金矿，但是，因为那真的只强调了数据收集的方面。

sentences.en: But it's been a very beneficial and productive relationship for both sides, I think.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，对于双方来说，这都是一个非常互利且富有成效的关系。

sentences.en: Well, great, Dr. Blake, this has been very fascinating.
sentences.zh: 好的，太棒了，布莱克博士，这非常引人入胜。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for joining us.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您做客我们的节目。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听。

sentences.en: To hear more episodes and to learn more about the Living Laboratory, please go to our website at speakingofpsychology.org.
sentences.zh: 要收听更多单集并了解有关“生活实验室”的更多信息，请访问我们的网站 speakingofpsychology.org。

sentences.en: With the American Psychological Association's Speaking of Psychology, I'm Audrey Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 这里是美国心理学协会的《心理学话语》，我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿。
